DSH 使用 Agent 页当前选择的配置目标。写入后请在 DSH 中确认工具是: DSH uses the configuration target selected on the Agent page. After writing, check that the tools appear in DSH and restart the corresponding client if needed.
API Key 无效或无权限: The API Key is invalid or unauthorized
Key 明文只会写入所选客户端的本机配置文件。: The plaintext Key is only written into the local configuration files of the selected clients.
Node.js 无需额外依赖，推荐使用；Python 需要本机有 python。: Node.js needs no extra dependencies and is recommended; Python requires python on this machine.
上游提供商配置由各接入协议共享，改动后所有协议同时生效。: Upstream provider settings are shared by all access protocols; changes take effect for all of them.
仅支持单选，默认为 Tavily。: Single selection only; defaults to Tavily.
仅显示已启用且至少有一个可用模型的提供商。: Only providers that are enabled and have at least one available model are shown.
仅显示该提供商下已启用的模型。: Only enabled models under this provider are shown.
任务编号或原提交编号，至少提供一项: Provide a job ID or the original submission ID
作为远程 MCP 服务，在支持 MCP 的客户端配置里填写地址即可接入。: Exposed as a remote MCP service; add the URL to any MCP-capable client.
使用已有账号生成或编辑图片，支持任务查询与本机文件保存。: Generate or edit images with existing accounts, track jobs and save files locally.
内部请求本站网关时使用的网关 Key；额度、限流与请求日志记在该 Key 上。: The gateway Key used for internal requests to this gateway; quota, rate limits and request logs are recorded on that Key.
参考图链接或已生成图片 ID；本地桥接还可传文件路径: Reference URLs or generated image IDs; the local bridge also accepts file paths
只保存新文件，不覆盖已有不同内容。目录权限写入客户端配置，更新配置时需要重新确认: Only new files are saved; different existing content is never overwritten. Directory permissions are written to the client configuration and must be confirmed again when updating it.
可选。留空时不传，由模型映射的「思考覆盖」决定。: Optional. Leave empty to omit it and let the mapping's reasoning override decide.
可选，每行一个已有绝对目录。输出目录默认允许读取；其他位置的文件不会读取或上传。: Optional: one existing absolute directory per line. The output directory is readable by default; files elsewhere are not read or uploaded.
图片占用 {used} MiB，生成中预留 {reserved} MiB。: Images use {used} MiB; active jobs reserve {reserved} MiB.
在支持远程 MCP 的客户端中填写该地址，并使用网关 Key 作为 Bearer: Fill in this URL in any client that supports remote MCP, and use a gateway Key as the Bearer token.
复制失败，请手动选择后复制: Copy failed; select and copy manually
复用「账号」页的登录态，不需要额外填写搜索密钥。账号停用或删除后不会自动换号。: Uses an existing login from the Accounts page; no additional search API key is required. Disabled or deleted accounts are not replaced automatically.
复用已有账号生图，不改变 Agent 的对话模型。实际调用遵守接入 Key 的模: Generate images with existing accounts without changing the agent's chat model. Calls follow the connecting key's model and provider permissions.
客户端调用超时设为 120 秒；后台生成超时由服务配置控制，未完成时通过任务编号: Client calls time out after 120 seconds. The service controls the generation deadline; query unfinished jobs by their ID.
密钥或账号登录态无效: The API key or account login is invalid
将按服务的工具执行超时（{seconds} 秒）同步写入客户端配置。: The service's tool execution timeout ({seconds}s) will be written into the client configuration.
将搜索、视觉等能力通过 MCP 或 Skills 接入客户端。: Connect clients to search, vision and other capabilities through MCP or Skills.
尚未配置图片生成，请先选择可用的生图模型并保存。: Image generation is not configured. Select an available image model and save.
尚未配置视觉模型，配置前调用方会收到“未配置”错误。: No vision model is configured yet; callers receive a "not configured" error until it is.
已有账号搜索只支持搜索，不支持网页抓取；请求会使用绑定账号的额度与出网设置。: Account-based sources support search only, not page fetching. Requests use the bound account’s quota and outbound network settings.
已检查保存的配置，未发起生图；账号实际额度与上游可用性以调用结果为准。: Saved settings checked without generating an image. Actual account quota and upstream availability are determined when making a call.
已绑定的搜索账号不存在，请重新选择: The bound search account no longer exists; select another account
已绑定的搜索账号已停用: The bound search account is disabled
已绑定账号不可用，请重新选择: The bound account is unavailable; select another account
已配置的 API Key 已失效（被删除或禁用），请重新选择并保存。: The configured API Key is no longer valid (deleted or disabled); select a new one and save.
当前提供商插件不支持账号搜索，请更新插件: The current provider plugin does not support account-based search; update the plugin
当前没有已安装/已配置的目标: Nothing is installed or configured yet
当前网关 Key 无权使用所选账号搜索来源: This gateway Key is not allowed to use the selected account-based search sources
打包为 Agent Skill，由 Agent2API 面板安装到本机客户端目录: Packaged as an Agent Skill and installed into local client directories from the Agent2API panel.
批量抓取 1～10 个 URL，使用后台选中的单个抓取提供商。: Fetch 1-10 URLs using the single fetch provider selected on the server.
批量搜索 1～10 条查询，并发调用后台选中的提供商后合并重复来源。: Search 1-10 queries in parallel with the providers selected on the server, then merge duplicate sources.
批量网页搜索不可用：所选提供商均未启用或未配置密钥。: Batch web search unavailable: none of the selected providers is enabled and configured.
批量网页搜索不可用：请启用来源并配置密钥或绑定可用账号。: Batch web search is unavailable: enable a source and configure its API key or bind an available account.
批量网页搜索可用：将使用 {ready}，未配置的 {missing} 会自动跳: Batch web search available: using {ready}; unconfigured {missing} will be skipped automatically.
批量网页搜索可用：所选提供商均已启用并配置密钥。: Batch web search available: all selected providers are enabled and configured.
批量网页搜索可用：所选来源均已启用并配置完成。: Batch web search is available: all selected sources are enabled and configured.
批量网页搜索至少选择一个提供商: Select at least one provider for batch web search
把 1～10 张图片与提示词交给后台配置的视觉模型，返回模型回复文本。: Send 1-10 images and a prompt to the vision model configured on the server and return the model reply text.
把下面这段合并到客户端配置的 mcpServers 里，并把 Key 换成你自己: Merge the snippet below into the client's mcpServers and replace the Key with your own.
把图片与提示词交给后台配置的视觉模型分析，并把模型回复返回给调用方的大模型。: Sends images and a prompt to the vision model configured on the server and returns the model reply to the calling model.
按参考图修改，仅在配置了可用编辑模型时提供。: Edit reference images; available only when a supported editing model is configured.
按描述使用已配置的模型生图，默认一张，会消耗账号额度。: Generate images from a description using the configured model. Defaults to one image and consumes account credits.
提供 REST API，任何能发 HTTP 请求的程序都可以携带网关 Key 直: Provides a REST API; any program that can send HTTP requests can call it with a gateway Key.
提供商尚未配置密钥: The provider has no API key configured
提供商尚未配置有效密钥: The provider has no valid API key configured
提供商插件暂不可用: The provider plugin is temporarily unavailable
提供商插件未安装或未启用: The provider plugin is not installed or enabled
提供商暂不可用或配置有误: The provider is temporarily unavailable or misconfigured
提示词，描述要让模型在图片中查看的内容: Prompt describing what the model should look for in the images
插件搜索能力声明不完整，请更新插件: The plugin’s search capability information is incomplete; update the plugin
插件返回的搜索来源格式不正确: The plugin returned search sources in an invalid format
搜索、视觉与生图共用网关配置。本机客户端的 MCP 安装在桌面端完成。: Search, vision and image generation use gateway settings. Install MCP into local clients from the desktop app.
搜索参数不符合该来源的要求: The search parameters do not meet this source’s requirements
搜索提供商没有返回来源: The search provider returned no sources
搜索服务拒绝了该账号，请检查账号权限: The search service rejected this account; check its permissions
搜索来源配置不完整: The search source configuration is incomplete
搜索账号不属于该提供商，请重新选择: The search account belongs to a different provider; select another account
搜索账号登录态已失效，请重新登录: The search account login has expired; sign in again
搜索额度已用完或触发限流: The search quota is exhausted or the rate limit was reached
支持多选。每次搜索会并发调用所选提供商并合并重复来源。: Multiple selection. Each search calls the selected providers in parallel and merges duplicate sources.
无法确认插件搜索能力，请更新或重启提供商插件: Unable to confirm search support; update or restart the provider plugin
暂无生图记录，连接 MCP 后即可让 Agent 生成图片。: No image jobs yet. Connect MCP to let your agent generate images.
服务端强制单次工具执行的超时上限（同一服务的 Skill / MCP / API: Server-enforced timeout for a single tool execution (shared by the Skill / MCP / API protocols of the same service). Installing MCP writes this value into the client configuration; after changing it, re-run "Update" in the client and reopen the session.
服务端强制单次工具执行的超时上限（同一服务的 Skill / MCP 共用）。安: Server-enforced timeout for a single tool execution (shared by the Skill / MCP protocols of the same service). Installing MCP writes this value into the client configuration; after changing it, re-run "Update" in the client and reopen the session.
本地桥接会在本机运行一个 node 脚本，支持直接传本地图片路径，推荐在桌面端使: The local bridge runs a Node script on this machine and supports local image paths; recommended on desktop.
本地桥接需要 Node.js 18 或更新版本，自动读取授权目录的参考图并保存生: The local bridge requires Node.js 18 or newer. It reads references from authorized directories and saves generated images. HTTP mode only returns download URLs.
本次提交的唯一编号，断线重试使用原编号: Unique submission ID; reuse it when retrying after a disconnect
查询原任务并取回图片，不再次生图或扣费。: Query the original job and retrieve its images without generating or charging again.
没有可用的生图模型，请先添加账号、启用对应插件并更新模型目录。: No image model is available. Add an account, enable its plugin and refresh the model catalog.
没有可绑定的启用账号，请先到「账号」页添加或启用。: No enabled account is available to bind. Add or enable one on the Accounts page first.
清理这次生成的临时图片？已保存到本机的文件不会被删除，原提交编号也不会重新生图。: Clear the temporary images for this job? Files saved locally will remain, and the original submission ID will not generate again.
点击「复制文档」可复制整份 Markdown 文档，直接发给对接方即可。: Click "Copy document" to copy the whole Markdown document and send it to integrators.
生成较慢时先返回任务编号。断线后查询原任务，不自动重画；超时不代表没有扣费。: Slow generations return a job ID first. Query the original job after reconnecting; no automatic regeneration. A timeout does not mean no credits were charged.
确定清除提供商 {name} 的 API Key？清除后该提供商将不可用，直到重: Clear the API Key of {name}? The provider will be unavailable until a new key is saved.
空白的 API Key 不会覆盖已保存的密钥。: An empty API Key will not overwrite the saved key.
管理可供客户端安装和运行的工具服务，并配置上游提供商与能力。: Manage tool services that clients can install and run, and configure their upstream providers and capabilities.
编辑可使用不同模型；未配置可用编辑模型时，不向 Agent 提供编辑工具。: Editing can use a different model. The editing tool is not exposed without an available editing model.
网络搜索与视觉分析：网关侧配置，改完立即生效。本机客户端的安装在桌面端完成。: Web search and vision analysis are gateway-side settings that take effect immediately. Installing into local clients is done on desktop.
聚合 Tavily、Querit、Firecrawl、Ollama Web Se: Aggregates Tavily, Querit, Firecrawl and Ollama Web Search for batch web search and page fetching.
聚合标准搜索服务及已有 WorkBuddy、Kiro 账号的搜索能力；网页抓取仍: Combines standard search services with search from existing WorkBuddy and Kiro accounts. Page fetching still uses standard services.
自动选择仅在所选提供商内遵守现有路由；固定账号仍受停用、冷却与额度限制，不会自动: Automatic selection follows existing routing within the selected provider. Fixed accounts still obey disabled status, cooldowns and quota limits; they are never replaced automatically.
至少选择一个搜索提供商: Select at least one search provider
要分析的图片（1～10 张），每张为 http(s) URL 或图片 data: Images to analyze (1-10), each an http(s) URL or an image data URI
要抓取并提取正文的网页 URL（1～10 个）: Page URLs to fetch and extract (1-10)
要搜索的查询，每条并发执行（1～10 条）: Queries to search, each executed in parallel (1-10)
触发上游限流: The upstream rate limit was hit
该协议已停用，已接入的客户端会收到服务停用错误。: This protocol is disabled; connected clients will receive a service-disabled error.
该协议通过 Agent2API 面板安装到本机客户端目录。: This protocol is installed into local client directories from the Agent2API panel.
该提供商不支持网页抓取: This provider does not support page fetching
该搜索来源使用 API Key，不接受账号绑定: This search source uses an API Key and does not accept account bindings
该搜索来源使用已有账号，不接受 API Key: This search source uses an existing account and does not accept an API Key
请先选择搜索使用的账号: Select an account to use for search first
请选择提供商与上游模型: Select a provider and an upstream model
账号搜索暂不可用，请检查账号及插件状态: Account-based search is temporarily unavailable; check the account and plugin status
账号搜索配置不完整，请重新选择账号或更新插件: Account-based search is not fully configured; select an account again or update the plugin
输入新密钥；留空保持不变: Enter a new key; leave empty to keep the current one
还没有可用的提供商，请先在「账号」页添加账号并在「模型管理」页确认有已启用的模型: No providers available yet. Add accounts on the Accounts page and make sure there are enabled models on the Models page.
还没有可用的提供商，请先在桌面端添加账号并确认有已启用的模型。: No providers available yet. Add accounts on desktop and make sure there are enabled models.
这是后台生成任务的时间上限。单次 MCP 调用最多等待 20 秒，未完成时返回任: This limits the background generation task. Each MCP call waits up to 20 seconds, then returns a job ID if unfinished. Queries never generate again.
这里管理的是「客户端能用什么」：服务是否对外提供、上游提供商与密钥、视觉分析用哪: This page manages what clients can use: whether services are exposed, their upstream providers and keys, and which model vision analysis uses.
远程 HTTP 只接受图片 URL 或 data URI，不需要本机安装 nod: Remote HTTP only accepts image URLs or data URIs; no local Node.js is required.
选择处理图片的上游提供商与模型。调用时会用内部 Key 经本站网关请求该模型，协: Select the upstream provider and model for images. Calls go through this gateway with the internal Key, reusing protocol translation, retries and failover.
选择安装目标、运行时与调用用的 API Key。Skill 包与密钥只写入所选客: Select install targets, runtime and the API Key for invocation. The Skill package and key are written only into the selected clients' local directories.
选择已有目录，图片只会写入此目录及其子目录: Select an existing directory; images are saved only there or in its subdirectories
选择要从中移除的客户端，未勾选的客户端保持不变。: Select the clients to remove it from; unselected clients are left unchanged.
选择要写入 MCP 配置的客户端。配置只动本服务那一项，客户端原有的其它 MCP: Select the clients to write the MCP configuration into. Only this service's entry is changed; other MCP servers stay untouched.
配置搜索与抓取所使用的上游提供商。调用方不再传递 provider，运行时始终使: Configure the upstream providers used for search and fetching. Callers no longer pass a provider; the saved settings are always used at runtime.
默认只生成一张。空间不足时先拒绝请求，不消耗生图额度；只清理过期结果，已保存到本: One image is generated by default. Insufficient storage rejects the request before credits are spent. Only expired results are cleaned up; locally saved files are unaffected.
